data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, the strong current accident year performance, offset by the back year reserve strengthening, has resulted in a claims ratio for the Syndicate of 54% for the year. Healthcare and Professional Indemnity ("PI") - particularly the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account, which has required some additional reserve strengthening on the older Years of Account have proven more problematic.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced overall back year reserve strengthening in 2014, primarily driven by increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims and additional reserve strengthening on older years of account, particularly within the Healthcare and UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity accounts in the Specialty division. Despite this, the current accident year performance was strong.
raw_causal_phrases: two very specific accounts that have required reserve strengthening
additional reserve strengthening on the older Years of Account
increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding for 2014 (i.e., 2013 closing balance) not available as the Balance Sheet only provides 2014 figures and no comparative column. Prior year development could not be quantified from the available information; only the direction (strengthening) and specific affected LOBs/events were identified.
